verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents a full general-ledger export in Excel, CSV and PDF, but only as a user export, not through an API. Its API is described only in general terms (embedded accounting, platform-to-platform integrations), with no documented general-ledger or trial-balance endpoints, and the OpenAPI probe found nothing. The MCP connector to Claude and the manual export are adjacent features, not a documented developer API for pulling the ledger and trial balance.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full general ledger and trial balance through a documented API in open formats
